rotation.note: Unattended run: FULL games keyword set used (core + every entry in sections.games.keywords), not a date-rotated slice. Date-based rotation (day-of-month 18) is applied only to EMPHASIS: YouTube channel rotation starts at index 18 mod 5 = 3 -> GDC, Two Minute Papers, Unreal Engine; and pool topics already covered in the last 14 days are pushed to the back of the query list.

retrieval_hint.why: Plain `site:` WebSearch returns stale evergreen pages for these game outlets; the published_time gate then kills most of them. Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items whose pubDate is inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then run WebSearch queries to fill gaps.
retrieval_hint.youtube_feed_pattern: https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<UC...> — resolve channel_id by fetching https://www.youtube.com/@<handle> and reading `channelId` / `og:url` in the HTML.
retrieval_hint.relevance_test: Keep only items where AI actually touches how games are made, played, or governed (tools, engines, models, pipelines, asset/voice/loc policy, labor + legal fallout). Drop pure hardware benchmark or pure game-release noise with no AI angle.
